verdict.rationale: Stripe documents sandboxes as isolated test environments that don't affect live data, and its test transactions don't move funds. Coding agents can provision an anonymous sandbox with working API keys via `stripe sandbox create`, with no account needed. MCP access is configured separately for live mode and sandbox, and Workbench Shell is read-only in live mode, so writes must happen in a sandbox. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven sandbox testing.
